# Abo Yussuf / CRIG Portfolio

> Abo Yussuf is a Champaign and Chicago creative developer who builds hand-coded websites, booking systems, e-commerce, automations, and SEO-ready web experiences for small businesses.

Canonical URL: https://gyussce.github.io/crigport/
Contact: poz4gan@gmail.com
Service area: Champaign, Illinois; Chicago, Illinois; United States
Primary audience: small business owners, local service businesses, restaurants, childcare providers, salons, coaches, contractors, and founders who need custom websites.

## What This Site Offers

- Custom hand-coded small business websites
- Mobile, tablet, and desktop responsive builds
- Booking and scheduling flows
- E-commerce and Stripe payment integrations
- Maps, CRM, API, and AI workflow integrations
- SEO foundations, launch support, domain setup, and SSL
- Ongoing care, updates, and priority support

## Packages

- Launch: custom website, responsive polish, SEO basics, domain, SSL, and live launch.
- Signature: Launch plus motion design, booking/scheduling, integrations, and copy polish.
- Empire: Signature plus e-commerce, payments, automation, AI workflows, and ongoing support.
